**Backlog:** [#71](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/71), checklist items #04–#06 (and preparatory aspects of #07). Related existing owner task [#67](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/67); [draft PR #68](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/68), head at initial inventory `cbb379fa4a4eaa9f576f3abcce2c2258d22cc551`. Re-verify live head and main before starting.

**Status: LOCAL PG17 BLOCKED / GITHUB ACTIONS MANUAL-RUNNER EVIDENCE TASK AUTHORIZED; GITHUB RUN NOT YET EXECUTED.** Codex's first local attempt at [issue comment 6243322555](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/74#issuecomment-6243322555) did not start PostgreSQL, so both before/after SQL results remain NOT_RUN. The owner's 2026-10-18 continuation authorizes a narrowly scoped disposable **GitHub-hosted runner test**, relayed at [comment 6249776555](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/74#issuecomment-6249776555); it does **not** approve the proposed migration, GitHub workflow merge, hosted Supabase access or extra privileges. A new Task/CP/EB must avoid the already verified 0012 collision with PR77. This issue is a request for **Codex primary implementer** to produce isolated disposable PostgreSQL17 evidence and a clean integration proposal. ChatGPT independently reviews exact-head source and observed tests; owner exclusively decides whether to accept any third SQL migration, merge, or authorize hosted use. The owner has **NOT approved** migration `supabase/migrations/20261015171325_restrict_book_privileges.sql` for remote application.

### Evidence problem

- The first two accepted source SQL migrations are `20261009000000_initial_author_books.sql` and `20261009010000_restrict_accepted_manuscript_dml.sql`.
- PR68 contains the **proposed, unapproved** `20261015171325_restrict_book_privileges.sql` and `tests/book_privileges_regression.sql` targeting the effective `books` TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER grants and cross-author behavior; earlier reports indicate PostgreSQL17 fixture **NOT_RUN**, so proof is missing.
- PR68 also edits older `implementation-foundation.yml` triggers that may restore overlapping automatic CI after PR70 merged; full PR68 rebase/CI reconciliation is separately required.
- PR65 contains earlier ChatGPT-authored content partly carried into PR68 by provenance-bearing cherry-picks. Do not blindly merge or silently claim Codex authored earlier commits.

### Permission envelope

1. Read accepted owner scope, PR68, original two migrations, proposed third migration and privilege fixture, current merged `main`/CI and relevant task/pack/bundle evidence. Do not claim Phase-B owner authorization from a Phase-A-only pack; if changing scope, commit a new owner-approved amendment or task and generate immutable pinned pack before edits.
2. In an isolated Codex branch/worktree, **run** the existing regression using a fresh disposable **PostgreSQL 17** instance with no linked Supabase project, authenticating only local disposable test roles. Capture actual command, version, log, exit code, original defect reproduction and corrected-state matrix. Ensure fixture cleanup and no real author data. On unavailable Docker/PG17, report BLOCKED with exact reason, never PASS.
3. Verify that with only migrations 1–2 the grant regression fails as expected and that with the **proposed** third migration and proper RLS fixtures it passes, including explicit TRUNCATE, unauthorized grants and cross-author INSERT/SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE negative cases.
4. Review possibility of SQL privilege side effects for API operations, PostgREST, future migrations and DDL; a passing synthetic PG17 regression does not itself establish hosted compatibility.
5. Record proof + defects in a new Task, ContextPack, ExecutionBundle and draft correction PR or evidence-only reviewed comment as appropriate. Do **not** mutate PR68 branch without Codex task authorization; preserve original PR authorship. Any merged-main CI trigger conflict must be identified, not reintroduced.
6. Return a clear owner decision packet: SQL diff and rationale; PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED status; whether the exact proposed third migration is ready for **separate explicit owner approval**, and what hosted checks remain.

### Forbidden / separate owner gates

- **No** hosted Supabase `db push`, `db reset`, migration apply, production/dev data modification, service-role keys, auth refresh or API secrets.
- **No** merger of PR65/68 or cherry-pick of migration into main without owner approval.
- **No** payment/billing changes, live users/manuscripts, deployments or security-hold waiver.
- The signed-out unexpired-JWT direct PostgREST risk remains unresolved separately (#09); do not claim real private-pilot readiness.
- This GitHub issue does not dispatch a Codex runtime or authorize the migration merely because the owner broadly asked to solve the remaining checklist.

### Acceptance

PG17 exact version and source SHA recorded; original default privilege defect objectively reproduced; proposed regression passed or failure honestly reported; negative tests cover privileges/RLS/cross-author; independent ChatGPT review complete; owner migration disposition recorded separately; no hosted writes.
